catalogue.catalogue_description: Represented authority for AI-assisted programming chat-session source profiles, ontology type vocabulary, relationship predicates, and adapter bindings.

base_document_type.name: AI-Assisted Programming Chat Session Document
base_document_type.description: An abstract document representing the propositional content of an AI-assisted programming chat session.
base_document_type.notes: This concept models abstract session content. Concrete files that embody the session are represented separately as file-copy concepts and linked through the represented document/file predicates.

base_file_copy_type.name: AI-Assisted Programming Chat Session File Copy
base_file_copy_type.description: A concrete computer file copy that embodies an AI-assisted programming chat session document.
base_file_copy_type.notes: This represents bytes in storage, not the abstract document itself.

document_has_file.name: propositional_information_thing_has_computer_file
document_has_file.description: Relates an abstract propositional-information document to one of its concrete computer file copies.

legacy_document_has_file_copy.name: propositional_information_thing_has_computer_file_copy
legacy_document_has_file_copy.description: Legacy document-to-file-copy predicate retained for repair and migration of earlier AI chat-session imports.

file_for_document.name: computer_file_for_propositional_information_thing
file_for_document.description: Inverse relation from a computer file copy to the abstract document it embodies.
